notes.heading: ### Subagent orchestration
text: **[LOCAL NOTE] This section was written based on the behavior of previous-generation models.**

For Claude Fable 5.1, see also `prompting-claude-fable-5-1.md > Let the lead agent keep working while subagents run`. The model guide wins for the target model.
Treat as indicative and cross-check against the guide for the target model before use.

notes.heading: ## Prefill Claude's response
text: **[LOCAL NOTE] The technique in this section no longer works for this skill's target models. Never suggest prefill.**

Prefilling the last assistant turn returns a 400 error on Claude 4.6 and later, which includes Claude Sonnet 5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Claude Opus 5, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Fable 5, and Claude Fable 5.1. The examples below are kept as is for the record, not as a recipe.

The replacements are in `prompting-best-practices.md > Migrating away from prefilled responses`: a direct instruction to drop the preamble, output wrapped in XML tags, or Structured Outputs and tool calling for API users.
